Empty shoe product angles are outside human garment/body reconstruction.
Worn dress references, technical passes and adjustable body consistency checks match scope.
Original game avatar design lacks worn-product reconstruction references.
Existing six-view body fitting needs sourced measurement overrides and silhouette validation.
Medical diagnosis is explicitly outside the skill scope.
Ordinary clothing size advice does not require body reconstruction.
Product wearer photos need separate reference channels and a sourced adjustable body.
Catalog wearer reference pack includes pose/depth guides and adjustable sourced proportions.
New outfit concepts on a fixed avatar do not reconstruct a product wearer.
Continuation needs adjustable body geometry, 3D verification and estimate provenance.
Structural guide completion and mesh validation belong to the wearer reconstruction handoff.
Adjustable neutral body parameters with provenance continue the multiview fitting workflow.
Seller photos drive anonymous adjustable wearer views, details and structural guides.
Measured-table normalization alone excludes inference, rendering and body fitting.
Single-photo retouching explicitly excludes a reference set or editable body.
Standalone pose/depth algorithm comparison excludes garment or body reconstruction.

Robotics skeleton/depth extraction excludes reconstructed bodies and garment assets.
